environment.description: Celery worker running on ECS Fargate with PostgreSQL RDS. The DB user 'celery_worker' has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all application tables. Redis broker is accessible on the internal VPC. No additional input validation layer exists between the web tier and the Celery queue - messages are enqueued directly from the Flask API handler.

config.network: internal VPC, no WAF on broker
